changes: API: send IsReturnPageCount=0 — filters 609/610 returned empty Data with 1.
API: children filter now uses `parent_original_id = <id>` (replaced `[Master Part Source] = '<name>'`); IsNewPaging=0.
API: extract `original_id` from a PI's Master Part Source value (e.g. `PRT-39382-901631 ...` → `39382`).
API: row lookup falls back from byName to byTitle and reads value from Display_text/Display/Text/Value (Display_text preferred so picklists like Status render their label, not the internal id).
UX: probe each child for grandchildren on expand — leaves render with no chevron, assemblies keep one. Concurrency cap 6, Page_Size 1.
UX: hide Copy As Link, In Pool, Is Branch, Original ID, ID, Quantity, Master Part Source columns (data still on row, just not rendered).
UX: merge Revision (PRT) and Part Revision (PI) into a single Revision column.
UX: removed cell hover-expand that caused row reflow; native title tooltip replaces it.
Design: new SVG icons — BOM (hierarchy tree, purple), Assembly (gear, orange), Part (hex nut, gray).
Design: added missing --accent-orange (#F5A623) token to design-system.css.
Config: settings.xml filter IDs updated to 609 (BOMs) / 610 (instances).
